name: ConFormBench
description: ConFormBench is a diagnostic benchmark for evidence-supported record maintenance in conversational form filling. Each item provides a form schema, prior record, visible dialogue history, and current user utterance, and defines the complete supported post-turn record. Version 1.0.0 contains 180 synthetic update turns across crash reporting, grant administration, patient administration, and patent disclosure; the frozen 36/144 development and held-out split; machine-readable schemas; gold records; five held-out baseline architecture runs; additional model-strength runs; evaluator and tool traces; robustness analyses; and pseudonymized materials from a locked 60-item independent-reconstruction audit. The runner, evaluator, baseline systems, analysis scripts, and ConFormBench Studio are available at https://github.com/tveigel/conformbench. The dataset contains no real patient records, crash reports, grant applications, or invention disclosures. Raw annotator submissions and private coordination records are not included.
